question: What is China's total CO2 emissions? (A) 9.7k (B) 11.7k (C) 12.7k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: B (11.7k). Bait: C (12.7k).
